eps.t: The Heart of the Elephant, Part 1
eps.d: After a meteor storm, Conan's father makes him a sword from the metal. Evil wizard Wrath-Amon wants all the metal to bring the God Set back from the dimension he was banished to. He turns Conan's family to stone when he doesn't get what he wants. Conan swears revenge and the quest begins!

eps.t: The Heart of the Elephant, Part 2
eps.d: Conan is captured and shackled to the oars of a slave ship where he befriends Zula, a mighty warrior prince. Then both are taken to work in the quarry pits of Wrath-Amon, where Conan plots escape with Zula.
Conan and Zula encounter Jezmine a circus performer who has star metal weapons. Her circus family has been kidnapped, and they'll be released if Jezmine retrieves a jewel from a wizard.

Conan and his friends go to the magical city of Xantos for help with Conan's parents. They meet Greywolf, a young magician, as well as his brother, sister and Mesmira, a visiting sorceress from Stygia. But she turns out to be bad news.

Conan and Greywolf travel east, where Conan finds himself helping a banished ninja clan to keep an ancient weapon called the Kari Dragon out of the hands of serpent men. But first he must complete his training with a martial arts sensei.
Conan and his companions are captured and are forced to participate in Gladitorial games. Things get worse when they're forced to fight each other to the death.

Wrath-Amon has discovered the location of the Heart of Rakkir, which will give him the power over a sea monster. He finds out that only a person with Atlantean blood may acquire the jewel. Luckily, Conan is a descedent of the Atlanteans.

Conan's band learn of a tribe of Celts whose Shaman wields a Star Metal talisman which supposedly increases magical ability. Fearing Wrath-a-mon, or other wizards may go after the talisman, Conan and his friends try to get the talisman first.

The winged monstrosity Windfang captures Jezmine and brings her to his hiding place high in the mountains. While Conan and his new ally Falkenar try to rescue Jezmine, Windfang's life story is revealed.
When Wrath-Amon enslaves a village and turns their chieftain to stone, Conan goes to investigate the matter and learns the secret behind the curse, but will it cost him his friends?
Conan, Jezmine, and Snag are travelling through a forest when they come across a band of warriors led by a youth, the ruler of the local land who was recently ousted by Serpent Men.
Conan rushes to rescue Jezmine after Windfang is ordered by Wrath-Amon to kidnap her. Imprisoned in the deformed dragon's lair, Jezmine learns of Windfang's human past.
Wrath-a-mon is close to finishing a pyramid, bringing him one step closer to summoning Set. Conan and all his companions gather to stop him.
